0022600115.text: Both teams come in 2-0, with Minnesota 3rd in the Northwest and 6th in the West and Toronto 2nd in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back, and 3rd in the East. The Timberwolves are 2-0 on the road and will play their first home game of the season here. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Minnesota won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 115-107 in Minneapolis on March 5, 2026. Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), while Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (heel, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot, fracture).
